lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੈ ਬਾਚੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਚੁ ਸਮਝੁ ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bikhai baach har raach samajh man bauraa re ||
lines.translation: So escape from corruption and immerse yourself in the Lord; take this advice, O crazy mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭੈ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਹਰਿ ਭਜੇ ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ ਗਹਿਓ ਨ ਰਾਮ ਜਹਾਜੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: nirabhai hoi na har bhaje man bauraa re gahio na raam jahaaj ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: You have not meditated fearlessly on the Lord, O crazy mind; you have not embarked upon the Lord's Boat. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਰਕਟ ਮੁਸਟੀ ਅਨਾਜ ਕੀ ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ ਲੀਨੀ ਹਾਥੁ ਪਸਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: marakat musatee anaaj kee man bauraa re leenee haath pasaar ||
lines.translation: The monkey stretches out its hand, O crazy mind, and takes a handful of corn;

lines.gurmukhi: ਛੂਟਨ ਕੋ ਸਹਸਾ ਪਰਿਆ ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ ਨਾਚਿਓ ਘਰ ਘਰ ਬਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: chhootan ko sahasaa pariaa man bauraa re naachio ghar ghar baar ||2||
lines.translation: now unable to escape, O crazy mind, it is made to dance door to door. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਨਲਨੀ ਸੂਅਟਾ ਗਹਿਓ ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ ਮਾਯਾ ਇਹੁ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiu nalanee sooataa gahio man bauraa re maayaa ihu biuhaar ||
lines.translation: Like the parrot caught in the trap, O crazy mind, you trapped by the affairs of Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਸੁੰਭ ਕਾ ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ ਤਿਉ ਪਸਰਿਓ ਪਾਸਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jaisaa ra(n)g kasu(n)bh kaa man bauraa re tiu pasario paasaar ||3||
lines.translation: Like the weak dye of the safflower, O crazy mind, so is the expanse of this world of form and substance. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਵਨ ਕਉ ਤੀਰਥ ਘਨੇ ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ ਪੂਜਨ ਕਉ ਬਹੁ ਦੇਵ ॥
lines.transliteration: naavan kau teerath ghane man bauraa re poojan kau bahu dev ||
lines.translation: There are so many holy shrines in which to bathe, O crazy mind, and so many gods to worship.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਛੂਟਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ ਛੂਟਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ॥੪॥੧॥੬॥੫੭॥
lines.transliteration: kahu kabeer chhootan nahee man bauraa re chhootan har kee sev ||4||1||6||57||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, you shall not be saved like this, O crazy mind; only by serving the Lord will you find release. ||4||1||6||57||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee ||
lines.translation: Gauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗਨਿ ਨ ਦਹੈ ਪਵਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਮਗਨੈ ਤਸਕਰੁ ਨੇਰਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: agan na dahai pavan nahee maganai tasakar ner na aavai ||
lines.translation: Fire does not burn it, and the wind does not blow it away; thieves cannot get near it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਸੰਚਉਨੀ ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਕਤ ਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam dhan kar sa(n)chaunee so dhan kat hee na jaavai ||1||
lines.translation: Accumulate the wealth of the Lord's Name; that wealth does not go anywhere. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮਰਾ ਧਨੁ ਮਾਧਉ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਧਰਣੀਧਰੁ ਇਹੈ ਸਾਰ ਧਨੁ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: hamaraa dhan maadhau gobi(n)d dharaneedhar ihai saar dhan kaheeai ||
lines.translation: My wealth is God, the Lord of Wealth, the Lord of the Universe, the Support of the earth: this is called the most excellent wealth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਰਾਜਿ ਨ ਲਹੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo sukh prabh gobi(n)d kee sevaa so sukh raaj na laheeai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The peace which is obtained by serving God, the Lord of the Universe - that peace cannot be found in kingdoms or power. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਧਨ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਸਿਵ ਸਨਕਾਦਿਕ ਖੋਜਤ ਭਏ ਉਦਾਸੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: is dhan kaaran siv sanakaadik khojat bhae udaasee ||
lines.translation: Shiva and Sanak, in their search for this wealth, became Udaasees, and renounced the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਮੁਕੰਦੁ ਜਿਹਬਾ ਨਾਰਾਇਨੁ ਪਰੈ ਨ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: man muka(n)d jihabaa naaraain parai na jam kee phaasee ||2||
lines.translation: One whose mind is filled with the Lord of liberation, and whose tongue chants the Name of the Lord, shall not be caught by the noose of Death. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਜ ਧਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨੀ ਤਾਸੁ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: nij dhan giaan bhagat gur deenee taas sumat man laagaa ||
lines.translation: My own wealth is the spiritual wisdom and devotion given by the Guru; my mind is held steady in perfect neutral balance.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਲਤ ਅੰਭ ਥੰਭਿ ਮਨੁ ਧਾਵਤ ਭਰਮ ਬੰਧਨ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jalat a(n)bh tha(n)bh man dhaavat bharam ba(n)dhan bhau bhaagaa ||3||
lines.translation: It is like water for the burning soul, like an anchoring support for the wandering mind; the bondage of doubt and fear is dispelled. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਮਦਨ ਕੇ ਮਾਤੇ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਦੇਖੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahai kabeer madan ke maate hiradai dekh beechaaree ||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer: O you who are intoxicated with sexual desire, reflect upon this in your heart, and see.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਘਰਿ ਲਾਖ ਕੋਟਿ ਅਸ੍ਵ ਹਸਤੀ ਹਮ ਘਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੧॥੭॥੫੮॥
lines.transliteration: tum ghar laakh kot asv hasatee ham ghar ek muraaree ||4||1||7||58||
lines.translation: Within your home there are hundreds of thousands, millions of horses and elephants; but within my home is the One Lord. ||4||1||7||58||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee ||
lines.translation: Gauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਕਪਿ ਕੇ ਕਰ ਮੁਸਟਿ ਚਨਨ ਕੀ ਲੁਬਧਿ ਨ ਤਿਆਗੁ ਦਇਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiu kap ke kar musat chanan kee lubadh na tiaag daio ||
lines.translation: Like the monkey with a handful of grain, who will not let go because of greed

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕਰਮ ਕੀਏ ਲਾਲਚ ਸਿਉ ਤੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਗਰਹਿ ਪਰਿਓ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jo jo karam keee laalach siu te phir garahi pario ||1||
lines.translation: - just so, all the deeds committed in greed ultimately become a noose around one's neck. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਿਰਥੇ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਇਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat bin birathe janam gaio ||
lines.translation: Without devotional worship, human life passes away in vain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਭਗਵਾਨ ਭਜਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਸਚੁ ਰਹਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat bhagavaan bhajan bin kahee na sach rahio ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Without the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, without vibrating and meditating on the Lord God, one does not abide in Truth. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਉਦਿਆਨ ਕੁਸਮ ਪਰਫੁਲਿਤ ਕਿਨਹਿ ਨ ਘ੍ਰਾਉ ਲਇਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiu udiaan kusam paraphulit kinahi na ghraau laio ||
lines.translation: Like the flower which blossoms in the wilderness with no one to enjoy its fragrance,

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਅਨੇਕ ਜੋਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਕਾਲ ਹਇਓ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: taise bhramat anek jon mahi phir phir kaal haio ||2||
lines.translation: so do people wander in reincarnation; over and over again, they are destroyed by Death. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਆ ਧਨ ਜੋਬਨ ਅਰੁ ਸੁਤ ਦਾਰਾ ਪੇਖਨ ਕਉ ਜੁ ਦਇਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: iaa dhan joban ar sut daaraa pekhan kau j daio ||
lines.translation: This wealth, youth, children and spouse which the Lord has given you - this is all just a passing show.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਅਟਕਿ ਜੋ ਉਰਝੇ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਰਿ ਲਇਓ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: tin hee maahi atak jo urajhe i(n)dree prer laio ||3||
lines.translation: Those who are caught and entangled in these are carried away by sensual desire. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਉਧ ਅਨਲ ਤਨੁ ਤਿਨ ਕੋ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਚਹੁ ਦਿਸ ਠਾਟੁ ਠਇਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: audh anal tan tin ko ma(n)dar chahu dis thaat thaio ||
lines.translation: Age is the fire, and the body is the house of straw; on all four sides, this play is being played out.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਭੈ ਸਾਗਰ ਤਰਨ ਕਉ ਮੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਓਟ ਲਇਓ ॥੪॥੧॥੮॥੫੯॥
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer bhai saagar taran kau mai satigur ot laio ||4||1||8||59||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, to cross over the terriffying world-ocean, I have taken to the Shelter of the True Guru. ||4||1||8||59||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ₈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee₈ ||
lines.translation: Gauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਨੀ ਮੈਲਾ ਮਾਟੀ ਗੋਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: paanee mailaa maatee goree ||
lines.translation: The water of the sperm is cloudy, and the egg of the ovary is crimson.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸ ਮਾਟੀ ਕੀ ਪੁਤਰੀ ਜੋਰੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: is maatee kee putaree joree ||1||
lines.translation: From this clay, the puppet is fashioned. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਛੁ ਆਹਿ ਨ ਮੋਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: mai naahee kachh aahi na moraa ||
lines.translation: I am nothing, and nothing is mine.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਰਸੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਤੋਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: tan dhan sabh ras gobi(n)d toraa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: This body, wealth, and all delicacies are Yours, O Lord of the Universe. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸ ਮਾਟੀ ਮਹਿ ਪਵਨੁ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: is maatee mahi pavan samaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Into this clay, the breath is infused.
